Tejpal Tanwar (born 5 January 1951) is a former member of the Haryana Legislative Assembly from the BJP, representing the Sohna Vidhan Sabha constituency in Haryana. He served as the MLA from Sohna during his term from **2014 to 2019** and was succeeded by Sanjay Singh.
In the **2024 Haryana Legislative Assembly elections**, he successfully contested and regained his seat in the Sohna constituency.
Early Life and Education
Tejpal Tanwar was born in **Ramgarh**, Haryana, on **5 January 1951**. He completed his early education in the region and later pursued higher studies in **[Field of Study]** from **[University Name]**. His involvement in student politics during his educational years played a crucial role in shaping his future career in public service.
Political Career
Tejpal Tanwar is a prominent politician affiliated with the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**. He has been actively involved in political activities since his student days and eventually went on to serve as a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) for the **Sohna constituency**.
Notable Contributions
* **Education**: Tanwar has worked to enhance the educational infrastructure in rural Haryana, aiming to make education more accessible for the children in his constituency.
* **Healthcare**: He has been instrumental in improving healthcare services, focusing on the construction of new healthcare facilities in Sohna.
* **Economic Development**: Tanwar has promoted economic development through initiatives supporting local agriculture and small businesses.
Election Performance
Tejpal Tanwar has had a strong record in the Haryana Legislative Assembly elections, winning the **Sohna constituency** multiple times.
* **2014 Haryana Assembly Election**: Tanwar won the Sohna seat, representing the **BJP**. However, he lost his seat to **Sanjay Singh** in the 2019 elections.
* **2024 Haryana Assembly Election**: Tanwar successfully contested the Sohna seat once again and defeated his opponent, **Rohtash Khatana**, from the Congress Party, regaining his position in the Assembly.
Previous Elections
Tejpal Tanwar has consistently been a prominent figure in his constituency, with significant wins in the 2014 elections and a successful comeback in 2024.
